Kuvitus: leikkipuiston keinuteline nurmi: Illustration: a playground swing set on a lawn in front of trees. Of two swings of equal length, a child sits on one at the extreme position of its swing, and the other hangs empty and still. A dashed arc shows the path of the swing.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: kitkattomal: Diagram, not to scale: a body on a frictionless horizontal surface is attached to a wall with a spring. Three moments one below the other. At the top the body is at the extreme position x = A to the right of the equilibrium position: the spring force and the acceleration point left towards the equilibrium position, and the speed is zero. In the middle the body passes the equilibrium position x = 0 moving left: the force and the acceleration are zero and the speed is greatest. At the bottom the body is at the extreme position x = −A: the force and the acceleration point right, and the speed is zero.
Kaavakuva: harmonisen värähtelyn paikka: Diagram: the position x of simple harmonic motion as a function of time t is a sine-shaped curve. The curve starts from the extreme position x = A, goes to the extreme position x = −A and returns to A. The amplitude A is marked from the equilibrium position x = 0 to the peak of the curve, and the period T between two successive peaks. The graph shows two and a half cycles.
Voimakuvio, heilurin punnus ääriasennoss: Force diagram: the bob of a pendulum at its extreme position, when the string makes an angle α with the vertical and the speed is zero. The string runs from the point of suspension at the top, and the bob is drawn as a rectangle aligned with the string. The weight G points straight down from the centre. The tension S of the string acts from the upper surface of the bob along the string towards the point of suspension. Dashed lines show the components of the weight: G n along the string away from the point of suspension and G t along the tangent of the path towards the equilibrium position. The tension is equal to G n, so what remains is the restoring component G t, whose magnitude is G sin α.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, kun jousivakio on: Graph to scale, for a spring constant of 20 N/m and an amplitude of 10 cm: the elastic potential energy of the spring E p is a parabola that is zero at the equilibrium position x = 0 and grows to 0.10 J at the extreme positions x = −10 cm and x = 10 cm. A horizontal line at the height 0.10 J is the total energy of the oscillation E. At x = 5 cm there is a vertical segment whose lower part from zero to 0.025 J is the potential energy and whose upper part from 0.025 J to 0.10 J is the kinetic energy E k.
Kaavakuva: vaimenevan värähtelyn paikka: Diagram: the position x of a damped oscillation as a function of time t. The curve oscillates on both sides of the equilibrium position, and its peaks decrease steadily. Dashed lines through the peaks show how the amplitude decreases. The interval between successive peaks, the period, stays almost the same.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: jousen varassa vä: Graph to scale: the position x in centimetres of a body oscillating on a spring as a function of time t in seconds from zero to 1.0 seconds. The curve is sine-shaped, and its peaks are at x = 3.0 cm at the times 0 s, 0.40 s and 0.80 s and its troughs at x = −3.0 cm at the times 0.20 s and 0.60 s. The grid spacing is 0.1 s and 1 cm.
